title: Party Reservation (Shaw Restaurant)
transcript:
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Good morning, Shaw’s Restaurant.
Speaker 0: Maria: Hi. I’d like to book one of your function rooms for a party, please.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Okay. Fine. How many people are you expecting for the party?
Speaker 0: Maria: Well, I’m not quite sure yet, but about 60.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Fine. So you will need a big room. And what day were you thinking of?
Speaker 0: Maria: The party’s for my daughter’s birthday. It’s her twenty first. Her birthday’s actually on the 18th of November, but that’s a Friday, So we thought we’d have her party on the 18th as that’s a Saturday. There’ll be lots of her friends there as well as all the family.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: And what time would you like the room for?
Speaker 0: Maria: Oh, I’m not sure. 07:45? Not too late.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Okay.
Speaker 0: Maria: And people will probably be leaving about eleven.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Fine. We’re open until 11:30.
Speaker 0: Maria: Excellent. And what about the menu?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: So do you want a sit down meal with waiter service?
Speaker 0: Maria: Yes. Not a buffet.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Right. Well, there are several options including different menus at various prices. So there’s the standard menu, that’s £25 per person.
Speaker 0: Maria: Okay.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Or the celebration menu which is three courses, it’s very popular, that’s £35.
Speaker 0: Maria: Okay. I think I’d rather go with that.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: And there’s also our gold menu. That’s a five course menu at £50.
Speaker 0: Maria: No. That’s definitely too expensive.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Okay.
Speaker 0: Maria: Now not all the guests eat meat. Will there be something for them?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Of course. We’ll make sure there’s a vegetarian option for each course.
Speaker 0: Maria: Great.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: And do you know if any of the guests have food allergies? Anything like shellfish, for example?
Speaker 0: Maria: I’ll need to check, but I do know that one of my daughter’s friends is very allergic to strawberries. Even just being near them can be a problem.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Okay. I’ll make a note to our chef to avoid those completely. Do you have any other requests for desserts?
Speaker 0: Maria: Well, I’d like a choice if possible. And could we have cheese as well?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Of course. No problem. We can provide that. Restaurant Staff: Now do you have any other requests I could help with? What about after dinner entertainment? You can book a band if you’d like live music.
Speaker 0: Maria: Actually, I think a disco would be best if you can arrange that.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: No problem.
Speaker 0: Maria: And I heard you might be able to put on a fireworks display. Is that possible?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: We aren’t offering that service anymore, I’m afraid. It was just too expensive.
Speaker 0: Maria: Oh, I see.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Now the menu package you’ve chosen includes a few other nice things.
Speaker 0: Maria: Oh, like what?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: We’ll decorate the room for you, which creates a nice party atmosphere. We can use different colors for the balloons: silver, gold.
Speaker 0: Maria: She loves pink, but actually, I think she’d prefer flowers to balloons. So let’s go for them instead in the same color.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: No problem. Now you mentioned that the party’s for your daughter. We make birthday cakes if you’d like one.
Speaker 0: Maria: Okay. Yes. We’ll definitely want a cake.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: And we can put a special message on top. What would you like?
Speaker 0: Maria: Congratulations and then her name. That’s Susie.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Fine.
Speaker 0: Maria: Now, one or two of the guests are coming by train, but they stop running quite early, so they’ll need a taxi to take them to the Forest Hotel after the party. Is that something you can sort out?
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Absolutely. Anything else?
Speaker 0: Maria: I think that’s all for now.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Okay. Well, just get in touch if you think of anything else. Now if I can just take some contact details, I just need your name and phone number.
Speaker 0: Maria: I’m Maria Nelson, and my number’s 07749132760.
Speaker 1: Restaurant Staff: Excellent. We look forward to seeing you soon.
